---
title: "Visit London"
format:
  typst:
    papersize: a5
    margin:
      x: 1.2cm
      y: 1.2cm
    fontsize: 9pt
---

```{=typst}
#set par(justify: false)
#grid(
  columns: (3.6cm, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 0.5cm,
  [
    #figure(
      image("images/big-ben.jpg", width: 100%, alt: "Big Ben and the Elizabeth Tower rising against a bright sky, with the Palace of Westminster below"),
      caption: [Big Ben in the sun. Photo: John Dillenbeck, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons.],
      supplement: none,
      numbering: none,
    )
  ],
  [
    #text(size: 9pt)[Five sights to start with. Most are free to enter; special exhibitions cost extra.]
    #v(0.3cm)
    #table(
      columns: (1.15fr, 1fr, 1fr),
      inset: 4pt,
      stroke: (x: none, y: 0.4pt + luma(180)),
      table.header([*Sight*], [*Price band*], [*Nearest tube*]),
      [British Museum], [Free], [Tottenham Court Road],
      [Natural History Museum], [Free], [South Kensington],
      [Tate Modern], [Free], [Blackfriars],
      [National Gallery], [Free], [Charing Cross],
      [Tower of London], [Paid ticket], [Tower Hill],
    )
    #v(0.4cm)
    #block(
      fill: luma(240), inset: 8pt, radius: 3pt, width: 100%,
      [*Tip from a local:* Stand on the right on Tube escalators and leave the left side clear for people in a hurry.],
    )
  ],
)
```
